name: sfc /scannow
title: Verify protected Windows system files
summary: Scans protected Windows files and attempts to replace corrupted copies.

examples.description: Runs a complete protected-system-file scan from an elevated Command Prompt.

permissions.notes: Run only from Command Prompt opened as administrator and follow organizational change policy.

risk.warning: SFC may replace protected Windows files. Save work, use approved support guidance, and do not interrupt the scan.

output_fields.name: Windows Resource Protection did not find integrity violations
found corrupt files and successfully repaired them
output_fields.description: Windows replaced one or more damaged protected files.

output_fields.name: found corrupt files but was unable to fix some
output_fields.description: Further component-store analysis may be required.

common_errors.meaning: The terminal was not opened with elevated rights.

common_errors.message: There is a system repair pending
common_errors.meaning: Complete the pending restart or servicing operation first.
